subject: Supplier portal magic-link timezone skew — Galactic Imports onboarding
messages:
From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@galacticimports.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@galacticimports.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Issue with supplier invite — magic link shows expired on our side

Hi Lauren,

We tried to complete the supplier onboarding link you sent this morning but every magic link we receive from the portal reports “Link expired” almost immediately. I attached a screenshot showing the error (screenshot-login-error.png) and a draft W‑9 (galactic_w9_draft.pdf) so you can see our info.

We're in PST, but our finance team suspects the link timestamp may be interpreted in UTC and gets rejected for being “older than 2 minutes.” Can you confirm whether the invite token is time‑bounded? We tried in Chrome (both desktop and incognito) and on Safari — same result.

We’re on a tight timeline to receive our first PO next week. Any quick workaround to get us fully activated would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Rajiv Menon
Head of Procurement
Galactic Imports
rajiv.menon@galacticimports.com
+1 415 555 0193

Attachments: screenshot-login-error.png (image/png), galactic_w9_draft.pdf (application/pdf)

From: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Issue with supplier invite — magic link shows expired on our side

Rajiv —

Thanks for the clear repro and for attaching the W‑9. Sorry you hit this onboarding friction.

Quick notes / immediate steps:
- We do issue single‑use magic links that expire after 10 minutes by default; however, there is a short server/client clock skew tolerance of ~2 minutes which can cause failures when clients are several minutes off UTC.
- Can you confirm the device time on the machine you used? If possible, please toggle the OS setting to set time automatically and retry one link.

Workarounds we can do immediately:
1) I can generate a one‑time manual activation code for you (valid for 24 hours) — this bypasses the magic link path and lets you set a password.
2) We can resend an invite with an extended expiry window (30m) from the Coupa portal while we investigate logs.

Ben (cc’d) — can you pull the invite token logs for the three sends to rajiv.menon@galacticimports.com and check the token TTL and server clock offsets? Also marking this as high priority — Galactic Imports is expecting a PO next week.

Rajiv — let me know if you want the manual activation code now or prefer an extended link. I can also coordinate a quick 15‑minute screen‑share to test.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Vendor Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@galacticimports.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Issue with supplier invite — magic link shows expired on our side

Lauren / Rajiv —

I pulled the auth logs for the three invite attempts (IDs: inv_20270411_A1, inv_20270411_A2, inv_20270411_A3). Findings:
- All tokens were issued with a 10m TTL.
- Two attempts show the client presenting the token 00:02:45 after issuance but our verification rejected them due to a client timestamp that was 3 minutes behind server UTC (we have a strict lower bound check to avoid replay).
- The third attempt shows the token presented ~00:00:30 after issuance and succeeded for one of the attempts but client cookie blocked the final redirect (likely SameSite handling in Safari).

Proposed immediate fix (low risk):
- I can generate a manual activation code (ACT‑GAL‑7f2c) and send it to Rajiv. That bypasses the time‑sensitive path and allows password set + upload.
- We'll also resend a Coupa invite with TTL extended to 30 minutes and mark it as "explicit resend for Galactic Imports" so support can trace it.

Longer term: extend skew tolerance to 5 minutes for external invites and add a UI warning when SameSite policies block the redirect. I'll open a ticket for the runtime change.

Rajiv — do you want the manual code now? If so, I’ll send it and unlock the account so you can upload the W‑9.

—Ben
Principal Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Lauren / Ben —

Thanks — the manual activation code worked. We used ACT‑GAL‑7f2c and were able to set a password and upload the W‑9. Screenshot attached shows the “Onboarding: documents uploaded” confirmation.

- When should we expect the first PO to be issued? We are ready to receive POs this week but want to ensure tax validation and 1099 classification are completed.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — please keep us posted on the longer‑term fix for the magic‑link TTL skew.

Best,
